# Vendored remote documentation

<!-- GENERATED by `hooks-daemon remote-docs`. Do not edit: this file is
     rewritten on every capture and refresh, and your edit would be lost.
     A deletion outside the CLI (e.g. `rm`) is not seen by those commands;
     `remote-docs check` reports the resulting drift, and
     `remote-docs index` re-renders this file on demand. -->

Documentation captured from upstream and stored locally, so it can be read
and grepped without a network round trip. Each entry names the local file
and the URL it came from.

Capture a new page:  `bin/hooks-daemon remote-docs add <url>`
Refresh everything:  `bin/hooks-daemon remote-docs refresh --all`
Re-render the index: `bin/hooks-daemon remote-docs index`
